Mission Local reported that MEDA was under contract to buy the four-story building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station, and planned to rehabilitate it into 62 permanent affordable homes. The units would include two single-room-occupancy units, 54 studios and six one-bedroom apartments. The project was contingent on city loan approval; the ground-floor businesses were expected to remain, with the spaces made ADA-compliant.
